eight_prospective_governance_rules.rule: Do not reinterpret D0349-A2 silently. A future separately reviewed, committed, published and remotely verified authorization must establish the replacement exact-parent rule.
Only B1-B5 bindings may be prospectively reconciled, and only after explicit authorization. Preserve historical V1 and its D0346 freeze unchanged.
Bind future consideration to the exact D0350 V2 source SHA-256 and D0350 authoring manifest. Do not silently edit or stage these artifacts.
F1/F2 runtime validation, if later authorized, must use separately bounded non-scientific fixtures and cannot run any preflight, readiness or ZE2 one-shot mode.

No source commit or corrected freeze until an independently effective successor authorization expressly permits it. A corrected freeze needs postcommit review, GitHub publication and exact remote readback.
A new exact-binding non-consuming preflight requires separate authorization after a corrected freeze is effective, followed by independent receipt review.
No readiness handoff or consumption is performed by design or source authoring. Keep the original one remaining readiness attempt and one remaining ZE2 attempt blocked until separate effective gates.
Preserve D0336 matching/output semantics, D0343 regeneration/attestation semantics, D0344 sequence and all fifteen D0345 readiness check identities and order.

seven_unresolved_blockers.name: IMPLEMENTATION_FREEZE_IDENTITY
seven_unresolved_blockers.observed: verify_freeze_identity still binds the historical D0346 implementation file set, V1 path, SHA-256 and Git blob identity.
seven_unresolved_blockers.prospective_disposition: A separately authorized successor verifier must bind only the corrected committed source path, SHA-256, Git blob identity and future freeze lineage. Historical D0346 metadata remains immutable.

seven_unresolved_blockers.name: PREFLIGHT_EXACT_PARENT
seven_unresolved_blockers.observed: preflight_identity requires the historical D0345 direct parent and original V1 source path.
seven_unresolved_blockers.prospective_disposition: Future preflight must verify the separately authorized corrected freeze parent and exact corrected source identity without relaxing worktree, branch or remote checks.

seven_unresolved_blockers.name: PREFLIGHT_RECEIPT_BINDING
seven_unresolved_blockers.observed: verify_preflight_receipt requires the historical D0345/D0346 commit relationship and original receipt binding.
seven_unresolved_blockers.prospective_disposition: Require a new non-consuming receipt with corrected freeze SHA, parent, source SHA, runtime identities and independent review. Never reuse the old receipt.

seven_unresolved_blockers.name: READINESS_RESULT_FREEZE_BINDING
seven_unresolved_blockers.observed: verify_effective_readiness_result retains the historical D0345 direct-parent expectation.
seven_unresolved_blockers.prospective_disposition: A future successor readiness result must bind the corrected effective freeze and independently approved successor authorization without changing the fifteen frozen readiness check IDs.

seven_unresolved_blockers.name: READINESS_AUDIT_COMMAND_PATH
seven_unresolved_blockers.observed: ReadinessReadGuard retains the original V1 Git hash-object command-path allowlist.
seven_unresolved_blockers.prospective_disposition: A future narrowly approved command-path binding may identify the exact corrected V2 file only. Do not generalize subprocess command allowlists.

seven_unresolved_blockers.name: D0349_DIRECT_PARENT_LINEAGE_COLLISION
seven_unresolved_blockers.observed: D0349 currently requires a corrected freeze to have D0349 as its exact direct parent. Prospective intervening governance commits would make that rule unsatisfied.
seven_unresolved_blockers.prospective_disposition: Before a corrected freeze can be committed, publish a separate effective prospective authorization amendment. It must explicitly set the corrected freeze's direct parent to that future authorization commit or another exactly specified and independently approved lineage. D0351 design is not that amendment.

seven_unresolved_blockers.name: F1_F2_STATIC_ONLY_VALIDATION
seven_unresolved_blockers.observed: D0350 completed 68/68 independent static checks, but no runtime compatibility or synthetic fixture execution.
seven_unresolved_blockers.prospective_disposition: Any future bounded compatibility testing requires separate authorization, clear non-consuming isolation and independent review. It must never enter D0345 readiness or create a ZE2 execution attempt.
